svg.title: Synchronization order parameter
svg.desc: What this figure shows: The Kuramoto order parameter summarizes phase coherence; the curve is a synthetic mean-field-style benchmark, not neural data. The plotted object is generated from r exp(i psi) = N^-1 sum_j exp(i theta_j). How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Synthetic coupled-oscillator benchmark. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
